info.title: AudioSmith Local API
info.description:
AudioSmith's local API: OpenAI's audio API under /v1 (point an OpenAI SDK's base_url at http://127.0.0.1:3901/v1, any api_key), AudioSmith's own under /api, streaming speech over a WebSocket, job events as Server-Sent Events, and an MCP server at /mcp.

**Security.** The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only and needs no key there unless Settings → Local API → Require an API key is on (then send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Host and Origin are checked: browsers may call it only from its own origin or the origins listed in the settings. Requests to /api that change something need the header X-AudioSmith-Request: 1 (or the key). With LAN sharing on, other devices reach a second port with the 6-digit PIN (X-AudioSmith-Pin header, or ?pin=) for speech, transcription and reading voices, or with the key for everything.

**Work.** Every request runs in the app's job queue at interactive priority, as the Studio's do. A request waiting longer than the queue limit (120 s) answers 503 queue_timeout; while the engine is down, 503 engine_unavailable with Retry-After. Models whose licence is not accepted answer 403 licence_required; models not downloaded 409 model_not_downloaded.

**Source.** AudioSmith is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 (AGPL-3.0): its source code is at https://github.com/hehehai/AudioSmith. /, /health and the capabilities document say so in source_url and license.

model.description: whisper-1 / gpt-4o-transcribe (Transcribe's Accurate model), gpt-4o-mini-transcribe (its Fast model), or a catalogue model. By default Qwen3-ASR (qwen3-asr-0.6b-4bit), or Whisper (whisper-large-v3-turbo-4bit) for a language Qwen3-ASR does not know. A removed model (parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3) is answered by the default, with the X-AudioSmith-Replaced-By and X-AudioSmith-Warning headers. gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize, or moss-transcribe-diarize-8bit, tells speakers apart (as speakers=true).

speakers.description: AudioSmith's extension: tell who says what with the speakers model (MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize, moss-transcribe-diarize-8bit; slower than the default; download it first). Segments of verbose_json and diarized_json get a speaker (S1, S2…, or the name given in Transcribe); SRT cues start with it. Not with translations.

response_format.description: diarized_json (OpenAI's format for gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize) transcribes with speakers: one segment per turn with its speaker.

post.description: Speech in any language to English text: the transcript is translated by the language model of Settings → Writing help (501 translation_unavailable without one). English speech is returned as transcribed.

get.description: Upgrade to a WebSocket. Send a JSON text message with GenerateRequest's fields (plus sample_rate: 24000 by default, 0 for the model's); receive {type: start, take_id, sample_rate, channels, encoding: pcm_s16le}, binary PCM frames as the take is made, then {type: done, audio_seconds, ttfa_ms, rtf, seed} — or {type: error, error}. {type: cancel} stops it. The socket serves one request at a time, as many as you like.

post.description: The Model Context Protocol server: tools generate_speech, clone_voice, design_voice, transcribe, list_voices, list_models, list_languages, check_health; resources voice://{id}, history://recent. Send X-AudioSmith-Client: <agent> for its bound voice. Stdio clients: AudioSmith.app/Contents/MacOS/AudioSmith --mcp-stdio.

type.description: OpenAI's error type: invalid_request_error, authentication_error, permission_error, not_found_error, rate_limit_error, server_error.

code.description: Machine-readable code: invalid_request, model_not_found, voice_not_found, ambiguous_voice, unsupported_format, unsupported_model, licence_required, model_not_downloaded, engine_unavailable, queue_timeout, unauthorized, forbidden_host, forbidden_origin, csrf_header_missing, too_many_attempts, translation_unavailable, or an engine code (oom, busy, input_too_long, unsupported_media…).

Error.description: OpenAI's error object. AudioSmith adds data next to the fields: licence_required carries model, licence, licenceName, licenceURL.

model.description: A catalogue model (id, repo or label, see GET /api/models), or OpenAI's tts-1, tts-1-hd, gpt-4o-mini-tts (any gpt-*-tts): the Studio's default model — or, for a saved voice the default cannot speak, a model that can.

input.description: The text, at most 4096 characters. Markup ([pause 500ms], [laughter] on models that take it) is honoured.

voice.description: A saved voice (id, or name when unique), a built-in speaker of the model (af_heart), default, or an OpenAI voice name (alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer, verse, marin, cedar), which picks a built-in speaker of that voice's gender.

instructions.description: Delivery (instruct models: Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice), or the voice to design on a design model without a saved voice (Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign, OmniVoice). Ignored by others (see X-AudioSmith-Ignored).

response_format.description: wav (default here: OpenAI's mp3 needs an encoder AudioSmith does not have), pcm (24 kHz 16-bit mono little-endian), aac (AAC-LC in an M4A container, through the engine's media worker). mp3, opus and flac answer 400 unsupported_format.

speed.description: 0.25–4; models without speed control ignore it.

stream_format.description: audio: the bytes, streamed (wav and pcm stream as the take is made, a sentence or so at a time, unless normalize is on); sse: Server-Sent Events speech.audio.delta {audio: base64} then speech.audio.done {usage}.

language.description: AudioSmith: BCP-47 (en, zh, pt-BR) or the model's own value.

seed.description: AudioSmith: the seed (reproducible takes on models with sampling).

exaggeration.description: AudioSmith: accepted for older clients; no model takes it any more (reported in X-AudioSmith-Ignored).

normalize.description: AudioSmith: Even out volume (mastering to −16 LUFS). Off by default here; on, the whole take is made before it is sent.

speaker.description: With speakers: its speaker's name or label (S1…).
